verdict.rationale: Gitea's own docs state that Git Large File Storage is available when enabled, with Git >= 2.1.2, so developers can store large binaries via LFS on their instance. The evidence is a single conditional mention with no further detail. Missing for 10: LFS configuration and storage-backend documentation, file locking or size/quota details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of LFS use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can store large binary files with Git LFS

citations.quote: Git Large File Storage will be available if enabled and if your Git version is >= 2.1.2
